author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: তুলনা/বৈসাদৃশ্য দেখিয়ে একটি paragraph লেখো। নিজে লেখার পর নমুনা ও checklist দেখো (Board: 15 marks)।

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'The Sun and the Moon'.
items.model: The sun and the moon are two heavenly bodies, but they are very different from each other. The sun is a star that has its own light and heat, while the moon is a satellite that has no light of its own and shines by borrowing light from the sun. The sun is much bigger and far hotter than the moon. The sun appears in the day and gives us light and warmth, whereas the moon appears at night and gives us soft, cool light. There is a difference in their effect too. The sunlight helps plants to grow and dries up wet things, while the moonlight only pleases our eyes with its calm beauty. On the other hand, both the sun and the moon are useful to nature. The sun is the source of all energy, and the moon controls the tides of the sea. In fact, both play an important role in keeping the balance of nature.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'Day and Night'.
items.model: Day and night are two parts of a full day, but they are quite opposite to each other. Day is the time of light, while night is the time of darkness. During the day the sun shines and the whole world becomes bright, whereas at night the sun sets and darkness spreads everywhere. There is a difference in activity too. In the daytime people go out for work and the world remains busy and noisy, while at night most people take rest and the world becomes calm and quiet. Birds and animals also move about in the day and return to their nests at night. On the other hand, both day and night are necessary for us. The day gives us light for work, and the night gives us rest and sleep. If there were only day, we could not rest, and if there were only night, we could not work. So, both day and night are gifts of nature for our welfare.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'Male Education and Female Education'.
items.model: Male education and female education are two parts of a nation's education, and both are equally important. In the past, male education was given much importance, while female education was neglected. People believed that boys should be educated to earn, whereas girls should stay at home. But this idea is wrong, because women are half of our population. There is no real difference in the ability of boys and girls; both can do equally well if they get the chance. An educated man can serve the country, while an educated woman can serve both her family and the country. Moreover, an educated mother can bring up her children in a better way, which a father alone cannot do. On the other hand, a nation with only educated males remains half-developed. So, both male and female education are needed for the full progress of a nation. We should give equal opportunities of education to boys and girls.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'A River and a Sea'.
items.model: A river and a sea are two large sources of water, but they differ in many ways. A river is a flowing stream of water that runs from a hilly place towards the sea, while a sea is a vast body of water that has no visible flow. The water of a river is sweet and can be used for drinking and cultivation, whereas the water of a sea is salty and unfit for drinking. A river is comparatively small and narrow, while a sea is very wide and deep. There is a difference in their gifts too. A river gives us fish, water for crops and a way for boats and ships, while a sea gives us fish, salt and a route for big ships. On the other hand, both a river and a sea are useful and sometimes dangerous. Both can cause floods and storms and take away lives and property. In truth, both are great gifts of nature and serve us in many ways.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'Games and Studies'.
items.model: Games and studies are two important parts of a student's life, and both are necessary for his full development. Studies train the mind, while games train the body. Through studies a student gains knowledge and prepares for his future, whereas through games he keeps his body strong and healthy. Studies are done inside the classroom with books, while games are played outside in the open field. There is a difference in their effect on the mind too. Long hours of study may tire the brain, whereas games refresh the mind and remove tiredness. On the other hand, both games and studies teach us useful lessons. Studies teach us patience and discipline, and games teach us team spirit and fair play. A student who only studies and never plays becomes dull and weak, while one who only plays and never studies fails in life. So, a student should give proper time to both games and studies to be successful.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'A Library and a Bookshop'.
items.model: A library and a bookshop are two places full of books, but they serve different purposes. A library is a place where books are kept for reading, while a bookshop is a place where books are sold. In a library one can read many books free of cost, whereas in a bookshop one has to pay money to buy a book. A library keeps a large collection of books of different subjects for the readers, while a bookshop keeps books mainly for sale and profit. There is a difference in atmosphere too. A library is calm and quiet, so readers can study there attentively, whereas a bookshop is busy with buyers and sellers. On the other hand, both a library and a bookshop help to spread knowledge and love of reading. A library helps the poor who cannot buy books, and a bookshop helps those who want to own books. So, both a library and a bookshop are very useful for a reading nation.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'A Bicycle and a Motorcycle'.
items.model: A bicycle and a motorcycle are two popular means of personal transport, but they differ in many ways. A bicycle runs by the force of the legs, while a motorcycle runs by an engine and fuel. A bicycle moves slowly and needs physical labour, whereas a motorcycle moves fast and needs little effort. In terms of cost, a bicycle is cheap and easy to maintain, while a motorcycle is costly and needs fuel and repairs. There is a difference in their effect on health and environment too. Riding a bicycle is a good exercise and causes no pollution, whereas a motorcycle gives off smoke and pollutes the air. On the other hand, a motorcycle saves time and carries us far quickly, while a bicycle is slow and suitable for short distances only. In spite of these differences, both are useful in daily life. However, a bicycle is better for health and the environment, so we should use it more for short journeys.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'Spring and Autumn'.
items.model: Spring and autumn are two beautiful seasons of Bangladesh, but each has its own charm. Spring is called the king of seasons, while autumn is known for its clear sky and soft beauty. Spring comes in the months of Falgun and Chaitra, whereas autumn comes in the months of Ashwin and Kartik. In spring nature wears a new dress; trees put on new leaves and flowers bloom everywhere. In autumn, on the other hand, the sky becomes blue and clear, and white kash flowers wave in the fields. There is a difference in the weather too. Spring is neither too hot nor too cold and is very pleasant, while autumn brings a mild and dewy freshness. On the other hand, both seasons please our hearts with their beauty. Birds sing and people feel cheerful in both. In fact, spring and autumn are two lovely gifts of nature that fill our minds with joy and delight.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'Wealth and Contentment'.
items.model: Wealth and contentment are two different things, and both are related to happiness. Wealth means money and property, while contentment means being satisfied with what one has. A wealthy man may have plenty of money, whereas a contented man may have little but is still happy. There is a difference in their nature too. Wealth can be gained and lost, and the desire for it never ends, whereas contentment stays in the heart and gives lasting peace. A greedy rich man is never satisfied and always runs after more, while a contented man enjoys peace of mind with his limited means. On the other hand, wealth is also necessary for our daily needs, and some money is needed to live. However, wealth without contentment cannot give real happiness. It is often said that contentment is the greatest wealth. So, we should try to earn wealth honestly but should also learn to be content with our lot.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'A Bus and a Train'.
items.model: A bus and a train are two common means of public transport, but they differ in many ways. A bus runs on the road, while a train runs on rails. A bus carries a smaller number of passengers, whereas a train can carry hundreds of passengers at a time. In terms of speed, a train is generally faster and steadier than a bus, especially for long journeys. There is a difference in comfort too. A train journey is more comfortable and safe, and one can move about inside it, while a bus is often crowded and shaky. On the other hand, a bus can go to many small places where there is no railway line, whereas a train can run only where there are rails. A bus is easily available and starts frequently, while a train runs at fixed times. In spite of these differences, both a bus and a train are useful for travelling. We choose one or the other according to our need and the distance.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'A Doctor and an Engineer'.
items.model: A doctor and an engineer are two respected professionals, and both serve the nation in their own way. A doctor deals with the health of people, while an engineer deals with construction and machines. A doctor treats the sick and saves lives, whereas an engineer builds roads, bridges, buildings and machines. There is a difference in their working place too. A doctor works in a hospital or a chamber, while an engineer works at construction sites, mills and factories. Both need long study and training to be skilled in their profession. On the other hand, a good doctor brings comfort to the suffering people, and a good engineer makes our life easy and modern through his creations. Without a doctor a nation would suffer from diseases, and without an engineer it could not build its towns and industries. In truth, both a doctor and an engineer are needed for the progress of a country, so both deserve equal respect.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'Manual Labour and Machine Labour'.
items.model: Manual labour and machine labour are two ways of doing work, and both are important in modern life. Manual labour means work done by human hands, while machine labour means work done by machines. Manual labour is slow and needs much time and energy, whereas machine labour is fast and can do a great amount of work in a short time. In terms of cost, manual labour is often cheaper in a poor country, while machines are costly to buy and run. There is a difference in quality too. Machines usually do work more accurately and evenly than human hands. On the other hand, machine labour reduces the need for workers and may cause unemployment, whereas manual labour gives jobs to many poor people. In spite of these differences, both kinds of labour are needed. In a country like ours, we should use machines where necessary but should not fully replace manual labour, so that our people do not lose their jobs.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'Handwriting and Typing'.
items.model: Handwriting and typing are two ways of writing, but they differ in many ways. Handwriting is done with a pen or pencil on paper, while typing is done on a keyboard of a computer or mobile. Handwriting is slow and depends on the skill of the hand, whereas typing is fast and easy once one learns it. There is a difference in appearance too. A typed page looks neat and even, while handwriting differs from person to person and shows one's personality. In handwriting it is hard to correct mistakes, but in typing one can easily edit and delete. On the other hand, handwriting needs no electricity or machine and can be done anywhere, whereas typing needs a device. In the modern age typing has become very popular because it is fast and clean. However, handwriting still has its own value, for it improves memory and gives a personal touch. So, we should learn both handwriting and typing.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'A Mother and a Father'.
items.model: A mother and a father are the two most important persons in a family, and both love their children dearly. A mother gives her love in a soft and tender way, while a father shows his love in a firm and quiet way. A mother stays close to the children, feeds them, nurses them and cares for their little needs, whereas a father works hard outside to earn money for the family. There is a difference in their duties too. A mother mainly looks after the home and the upbringing of the children, while a father looks after the security and the wants of the whole family. On the other hand, both parents guide their children towards the right path. A mother teaches love and patience, and a father teaches courage and discipline. In truth, the love of a mother and a father cannot be compared, for both are equally great. So, we should love, respect and serve both our parents.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'Solar Energy and Electricity from Fuel'.
items.model: Solar energy and electricity from fuel are two important sources of power, but they differ in many ways. Solar energy comes from the sunlight, while electricity from fuel is produced by burning gas, coal or oil. Solar energy is a renewable source that will never run out, whereas fuel is limited and will finish one day. There is a difference in their effect on the environment too. Solar energy is clean and causes no pollution, while burning fuel gives off smoke and harmful gases that pollute the air. In terms of cost, setting up solar panels needs money at first but then gives free power, whereas fuel-based electricity has a continuous cost. On the other hand, solar energy depends on sunlight and cannot be produced at night or on cloudy days, while fuel-based electricity can be produced at any time. In spite of this, solar energy is safer and better for our future. So, we should use more solar energy to save our environment.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'A King and a Farmer'.
items.model: A king and a farmer are two very different persons in society, yet both are important in their own way. A king rules over a country and lives in a grand palace, while a farmer works in the field and lives in a humble hut. A king enjoys wealth, power and comfort, whereas a farmer leads a hard and simple life. A king gives orders and is served by many people, while a farmer works with his own hands from morning till evening. There is a difference in their peace of mind too. A king is often worried about his throne and safety, whereas a farmer, though poor, often sleeps in peace after his day's labour. On the other hand, both a king and a farmer are needed by society. A king keeps order in the country, and a farmer feeds the whole nation with the food he grows. In fact, a country cannot run without either of them, so both deserve honour.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'A Newspaper and a Textbook'.
items.model: A newspaper and a textbook are two kinds of reading material, but they serve different purposes. A newspaper gives us the latest news of home and abroad, while a textbook gives us the lessons of a particular subject. A newspaper is published every day and changes daily, whereas a textbook is printed once and remains the same for a long time. There is a difference in their aim too. A newspaper aims to inform people about current events, while a textbook aims to teach students knowledge step by step. A newspaper is read quickly and then thrown away, whereas a textbook is kept and studied carefully for the whole year. On the other hand, both a newspaper and a textbook increase our knowledge. A textbook builds the base of our education, and a newspaper keeps us aware of the wider world. So, a good student should read both his textbooks and the newspaper to become truly educated and aware.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'Gold and Iron'.
items.model: Gold and iron are two well-known metals, but they differ greatly in nature and use. Gold is a precious metal, while iron is a common and cheap metal. Gold is bright yellow and shines beautifully, whereas iron is dull grey and rusts in the open air. Gold is very costly and used mainly for making ornaments and coins, while iron is cheap and used for making tools, machines and buildings. There is a difference in their strength too. Iron is hard and strong and can bear great weight, whereas gold is soft and cannot be used for heavy work. On the other hand, in daily life iron is far more useful than gold. We could not build our houses, bridges and factories without iron, but we can live without gold. In truth, though gold is more valuable in price, iron is more valuable in use. So, both metals have their own importance in human life.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'Science and Commerce as groups of study'.
items.model: Science and commerce are two important groups of study at the college level, and each has its own value. Science deals with nature and its laws, while commerce deals with trade, business and money. In the science group students read physics, chemistry, biology and mathematics, whereas in the commerce group they read accounting, management and economics. There is a difference in their future scope too. A science student can become a doctor, an engineer or a scientist, while a commerce student can become an accountant, a banker or a businessman. Science is often considered harder and needs more practice, whereas commerce is comparatively easier for many students. On the other hand, both groups open the door to good careers and serve the nation in different ways. Science brings new inventions and cures diseases, and commerce runs the trade and economy of the country. So, a student should choose a group according to his own interest and ability.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'A Hill and a Plain'.
items.model: A hill and a plain are two different kinds of land, and each has its own features. A hill is a high and raised land, while a plain is a flat and low land. A hill is full of ups and downs and is covered with trees and rocks, whereas a plain is smooth and good for farming. Life on a hill is hard, and travelling there is difficult, while life on a plain is easy and comfortable. There is a difference in their use too. A plain is suitable for growing crops, building houses and making roads, whereas a hill is suitable for growing tea, timber and fruits and for enjoying natural beauty. On the other hand, both a hill and a plain are useful and beautiful in their own way. A plain feeds the people with its crops, and a hill attracts tourists with its scenery. In fact, both are precious gifts of nature and add to the beauty and wealth of a country.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'A Town School and a Village School'.
items.model: A town school and a village school are two kinds of educational institution, and they differ in several ways. A town school usually has good buildings, furniture and facilities, while a village school often has poor buildings and few facilities. A town school gets many well-trained teachers, whereas a village school sometimes suffers from a shortage of good teachers. In a town school there are libraries, laboratories and computers, while many village schools do not have these things. There is a difference in the environment too. A village school stands in a calm and open place full of fresh air, whereas a town school stands amid noise and crowd. On the other hand, students of both schools sit for the same examinations and can do equally well if they study hard. Many great men of our country studied in village schools. So, though a town school has more facilities, a village school is no less important in building the nation.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'Traditional Learning and Online Learning'.
items.model: Traditional learning and online learning are two methods of education, and both have their good and bad sides. In traditional learning students go to school and learn directly from teachers in the classroom, while in online learning they learn from home through the internet. In a traditional class students can ask questions and get instant answers, whereas in online learning direct contact with the teacher is limited. Traditional learning helps students mix with friends and take part in games, while online learning often makes them lonely. There is a difference in cost and reach too. Traditional learning needs a school building and travel, whereas online learning saves time and travel cost and can reach distant places. On the other hand, online learning fully depends on electricity, devices and the internet, which many poor students do not have. In spite of these differences, both aim at spreading education. In fact, a mixture of traditional and online learning can bring the best result for students.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে
